//: Shared compiler options for the npm workspace members. Each member has its
own tsconfig.json that extends this and sets `include`.
extend this — they are not workspace members and their configs answer to
their own bundlers (React Router / tsup). Keep this file about the members.
`erasableSyntaxOnly` is the load-bearing one: it makes tsc reject the
constructs Node's native type-stripping cannot execute (enum, namespace,
parameter properties). Without it, `npm run tokens` would fail at runtime
NOTE: `"//"`-prefixed keys are only tolerated at the TOP LEVEL of a
tsconfig. Inside `compilerOptions` they are unknown options and tsc exits
with TS5025, so keep commentary out here.
//allowImportingTsExtensions: Relative imports in workspace members are written with a literal `.ts`
extension, e.g. `import { x } from './models.ts'`. That is deliberate and
the only specifier that works everywhere these packages run.
Members have no build step (package.json exports `./src/*.ts` directly),
and `moduleResolution: NodeNext` requires an explicit extension on relative
'./models.ts'  — needs this flag; works under tsc, Node >=24 native
Only the third is right, and the second is the dangerous one: it fails at
